headlines.description: — Abimelec Ortiz hit his second career home run, Will Dion led a bullpen outing that allowed one run in 6 1/3 innings and the Washington Nationals beat the Cincinnati Reds 7-1 on Sunday to sweep the series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ortiz hits 2nd career homer, Dion leads strong bullpen outing as Nationals beat Reds 7-1

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Max Muncy hit a tiebreaking RBI double off the Green Monster against closer Aroldis Chapman in the ninth inning and the Athletics rallied past the Boston Red Sox 4-3 for their first series win after losing 12 straight.
headlines.shortLinkText: Max Muncy's tiebreaking RBI lifts A's past Red Sox for their first series win since mid-June

events.name: Atlanta Braves at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Michael Harris II opened the 10th inning with an RBI single, and the Atlanta Braves beat the New York Yankees 2-1 on Sunday to prevent a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Michael Harris II hits tiebreaking single in 10th inning as Braves edge Yankees 2-1

events.name: New York Mets at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Bo Bichette went 5 for 5 with a three-run double and scored three times, Luis Robert Jr. homered and drove in four, and the New York Mets routed the Pittsburgh Pirates 11-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Bichette goes 5 for 5 and Sean Manaea strikes out 11 in Mets' 11-1 rout of Pirates

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Kyle Schwarber hit two home runs, Derek Hill singled with the bases loaded in the 12th inning and the Philadelphia Phillies avoided a three-game series sweep with a 7-6 win over the Toronto Blue Jays on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schwarber hits 2 HRs, Hill delivers RBI single in 12th inning as Phillies beat Blue Jays 7-6

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Kyle Stowers tripled, singled and drove in two runs before exiting because of left hamstring discomfort in the fifth inning, and the Miami Marlins beat the Los Angeles Angels 12-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stowers has 2 hits and 2 RBIs, then leaves with hamstring discomfort as Marlins beat Angels 12-3

events.name: Chicago Cubs at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Ian Happ hit a two-run homer, Miguel Amaya added a three-run shot and the Chicago Cubs beat the Kansas City Royals 10-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Happ and Amaya homer to help Boyd improve to 8-1 as the Cubs beat the Royals 10-2

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery’s 26th homer, a three-run shot, capped Chicago’s four-run third inning and the White Sox held on to beat the Cleveland Guardians 5-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colson Montgomery hits 3-run homer and White Sox top Guardians 5-3 to increase AL Central lead

headlines.description: — Jake Bauers singled home the winning run in the bottom of the 10th after Luis Lara made a spectacular run-saving catch in the top half of the inning, and the Milwaukee Brewers edged the Minnesota Twins 4-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Bauers' hitting and Luis Lara's fielding prove pivotal as Brewers beat Twins 4-3 in 10 innings

events.name: Colorado Rockies at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — JJ Wetherholt hit a go-ahead double, Alec Burleson homered and the St. Louis Cardinals used a three-run eighth inning to beat the Colorado Rockies 7-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: JJ Wetherholt hits tiebreaking double and Alec Burleson homers as Cardinals top Rockies 7-4

headlines.description: — Pete Alonso had his first two-homer game with the Orioles and drove in four runs as Baltimore broke out of a scoring slump and beat the Texas Rangers 10-5 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Alonso has his first two-homer game with the Orioles in a 10-5 win over the Rangers

events.name: Detroit Tigers at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Hao-Yu Lee drove in the go-ahead run in the 10th inning with a pinch-hit single and the Detroit Tigers beat the San Francisco Giants 3-1 on Sunday in the rubber game of their series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lee's pinch-hit single in 10th sends Tigers past Giants 3-1 after Melton and Webb duel on mound

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Eduardo Rodriguez struck out nine in seven strong innings and the Arizona Diamondbacks clinched their first season series over the Los Angeles Dodgers since 2018 with a 4-2 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eduardo Rodriguez strikes out 9 and Diamondbacks beat struggling Dodgers 4-2

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Cedric Mullins' RBI single in the fifth inning put Tampa Bay ahead and Ian Seymour pitched six innings of one-run ball as the Rays beat the Seattle Mariners 4-1 Sunday to complete a three-game series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mullins drives in go-ahead run, Seymour works 6 strong innings as AL-best Rays sweep Mariners

events.name: Houston Astros at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Fernando Tatis Jr. hit a go-ahead, three-run homer and pinch-hitter Austin Hays connected for a two-run shot in his first at-bat with San Diego as the Padres beat the AL West-leading Houston Astros 7-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fernando Tatis Jr. and newcomer Austin Hays power Padres to 7-2 victory over Astros
